# The Children's Dental Center

> A pediatric dental practice in Central New Jersey led by Dr. Julianne Kane, specializing in preventive care, emergency services, and orthodontics for children with family-focused resources and education.

The Children's Dental Center serves families in the Somerville, New Jersey area with comprehensive pediatric dental services. The practice emphasizes patient education, anxiety management, and evidence-based care grounded in ADA standards and best practices.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Cavity prevention
- Preventive care
- Oral hygiene

- Dr. Julianne Kane
- Dental anxiety management

## Oral Hygiene & Care Education

- [Healthy Habits, Healthy Teeth: 5 Important Oral Hygiene Behaviors to Teach your Children](https://thechildrensdentalcenter.com/healthy-habits-healthy-teeth-5-important-oral-hygiene-behaviors-to-teach-your-children): Five key oral hygiene behaviors and brushing techniques for kids
- [Which toothpaste should I use?](https://thechildrensdentalcenter.com/which-toothpaste-should-i-use): Dr. Kane's recommendations on ADA-approved toothpaste selection
- [Is An Electric Toothbrush Right For Your Child?](https://thechildrensdentalcenter.com/is-an-electric-toothbrush-right-for-your-child): Dr. Kane's guide on selecting electric toothbrushes for children
- [The Importance of the ADA Seal of Acceptance](https://thechildrensdentalcenter.com/the-importance-of-the-ada-seal-of-acceptance): Guide to ADA Seal certification for toothpaste and mouthwash products
- [Chew on This: How Gum Can Help Your Teeth](https://thechildrensdentalcenter.com/chew-on-this-how-gum-can-help-your-teeth): Benefits of sugar-free gum with xylitol and fluoride for cavity prevention

## Dental Health & Cavity Prevention

- [Common Dental Myths You Shouldn't Believe](https://thechildrensdentalcenter.com/common-dental-myths-you-shouldnt-believe): Debunk dental myths about cavity prevention and gum disease in kids
- [These Unexpected Foods Might be Giving your Kids Cavities](https://thechildrensdentalcenter.com/these-unexpected-foods-might-be-giving-your-kids-cavities): Educational article on hidden cavity-causing foods in children's diets
